name: American Express SimplyCash Plus® Business Card
notes: American Express states that SimplyCash Plus is being replaced by Blue Business Cash and is no longer accepting new applications. The official comparison page does not state the exact application-withdrawal or account-conversion date; its July 5, 2019 rate date applies to the successor's APR, not this card's lifecycle. Historical fees and rewards remain unverified.
